set.live_notice: Changes apply immediately to uploads, processing and the public chat. No restart is needed.
set.mock_provider: The server is running the test (mock) AI provider. Settings are stored but no real model is called until AI_PROVIDER is set to openai.

set.empty_ph: Paste an API key (Groq, Together AI, ...)

set.env_hint: Used as the last fallback after the keys above.
set.env_missing: No key is set in the server environment.
set.env_placeholder: The server environment contains a placeholder value, not a real key.
set.no_keys: No usable cloud key. Roles routed to the cloud provider cannot work until a key is saved.
set.security_note: Keys are encrypted (AES-256-GCM) before they are stored and are never sent back to the browser. Only the last 4 characters are shown. Every change is recorded in the activity log.
set.no_keys_ok: No cloud key is stored. That is fine: every role currently runs on the local engine.

set.provider_saved: Cloud provider saved and active now.
set.missing_models: The key works, but these configured models are not available on this provider: {list}
set.local_hint: Runs open-source models on this server, so the data never leaves it. By default it computes the search index embeddings (bge-m3).
set.local_key_ph: Only needed if the local endpoint requires a key
set.local_key_hint: Ollama inside Docker needs no key. Stored encrypted like the cloud keys.
set.local_saved: Local endpoint saved and active now.
set.pull_title: Download a model to the local engine
set.pull_hint: Ollama only. The download runs in the background and the model is kept on the server volume.
set.tools_hint: Tesseract reads text from images locally (OCR fallback), pdftoppm/pdfinfo render scanned PDF pages, and ffmpeg prepares audio and video for transcription.
set.routing_hint: Choose where each task runs and which model it uses. Changes apply immediately, without a restart.
set.role_chat_hint: Answers questions in the public chat from the retrieved excerpts.
set.role_vision_hint: Reads text from images and scanned PDF pages.
set.role_embeddings_hint: Turns text into vectors for semantic search. Changing it requires rebuilding the index.
set.role_transcription_hint: Converts audio and video speech to text (Whisper).
set.tesseract_fallback: If the vision model fails or finds no text, retry the page with local Tesseract
set.pdf_ocr_auto: Automatic: only pages without a text layer

set.routing_saved: Model routing saved and active now.

e2e.title: End-to-end self-test
e2e.hint: Uploads a small temporary document, processes it with the live AI key, checks the admin statistics, asks the public chat about it, then deletes it. Use it to prove the whole platform works together.
e2e.running: Running the self-test. This usually takes 10 to 60 seconds...
e2e.passed: All stages passed. Uploads are processed and immediately searchable in the public chat.
e2e.failed_summary: The self-test found a problem. See the failed stage below.
e2e.stage_chat_retrieval: Found by the public chat search
e2e.f_answer_missing: The answer did not contain the verification code

idx.title: Search index
idx.hint: Every chunk records the embedding model that produced it. Only chunks from the active model are searched, so old and new vectors are never mixed.
idx.stale_notice: {n} document(s) were indexed with a previous embedding model and are not searchable until the index is rebuilt.
idx.threshold_hint: Minimum match score (0.05 to 0.95) for an excerpt to be used in an answer. About 0.40 suits bge-m3; lower finds more, higher is stricter.
idx.rebuild_hint: First a test embedding call checks the active model; nothing is deleted if it fails. Then stale vectors are removed and the documents are processed again (with OCR where needed). Try a dry run first.
idx.confirm_msg: Stale vectors will be removed and the selected documents re-indexed with "{model}". Searches return fewer results until processing finishes.
idx.preflight_ok: Test embedding call succeeded ({n} dimensions, {ms} ms).
idx.preflight_failed: Test embedding call failed, so a real rebuild would stop before deleting anything
idx.would: Would re-index {docs} document(s) and remove {chunks} old chunk(s).
idx.did: {docs} document(s) queued for re-indexing, {chunks} old chunk(s) removed.
